job.title: Manufacturing Operator
job.description:
South West Personnel are proud to partner with a global leader in the manufacture and maintenance of cable belt conveyor systems. Due to ongoing demand and business growth, our client has immediate opportunities for Manufacturing Operators to join their manufacturing team at the Harvey facility.

If you are seeking a new career opportunity, have an industrial working background and a genuine interest in mechanical and hands-on work, this could be the move you have been waiting for.

Work is undertaken within a clean, organised factory environment with minimal dust and noise. You will be well supported through a comprehensive induction and training program, provided with detailed work instructions and PPE, and become part of a hard-working, friendly and respectful team.

The Role

As a General Manufacturing Operator, your duties will support the quality manufacture of conveyor belts and associated equipment used in critical overland conveyor operations within the mining industry.

Tasks may include

  • Operating rubber extrusion machines to produce conveyor belts
  • Steel rod preparation, including machine cutting, bending and spray-painting
  • Belt press production, final QA checks and repair inspections
  • Grit blasting, painting, polyurethane moulding and hand trimming of steel rims and tyres
  • Final assembly of pulleys supporting conveyor belt systems
  • General industrial labouring including housekeeping, sweeping, high-pressure hosing and cleaning

Essential Attributes

  • A strong work ethic, reliability and attention to detail
  • Commitment to working a 38-hour rostered week
  • A safety-first mindset and understanding of industrial WHS requirements
  • Ability to follow instructions and work effectively within a team
  • Willingness to complete a pre-employment medical and drug & alcohol screen
  • A White Card and prior labouring experience is desirable

Shift Details

Usual roster hours are 5:00am - 2:30pm Monday to Thursday. Hours outside of this attract penalties. Occasionally overtime is offered on a Friday.

These positions are Drive-In Drive-Out (DIDO) and suited to candidates living within a 30-minute commuting distance to Harvey.

If you are a reliable and motivated individual keen to learn the unique process of conveyor belt manufacturing, we encourage you to APPLY NOW.

South West Personnel is committed to building a diverse and inclusive workforce. We strongly encourage applications from Indigenous Australians and women.
